From the flux peak of the IR transient as measured by Spitzer/IRAC as well as constraints on dust composition and size from the JWST spectrum, we estimate a total dust mass formed in the outburst of 6.6 $\pm$ 0.4 $\times$ 10$^{-6}$ $M_{\odot}$. Assuming a minimum orbital period of 12 years, this corresponds to a period-averaged dust production rate of $\lesssim$ 5.5 $\times$ 10$^{-7}$ $M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$. These observations suggest that even a single WC system can contribute to the dust budget at subsolar metallicities, and that such systems are an important source of carbonaceous dust grains in the early universe.

title: ELVES-Dwarf. II. A Systematic Search for Satellite Systems of Dwarf Galaxies in the Local Volume
background_knowledge:
在宇宙学标准模型（$\Lambda$CDM）的框架下，星系形成理论预测了显著的层级结构形成过程：大质量暗物质晕通过吸积较小的子晕（subhalos）逐步增长。这些被主晕捕获的小质量星系即为主星系的“卫星星系”（satellite galaxies）。研究卫星星系的丰度、质量函数（Satellite Luminosity/Stellar Mass Function）以及空间分布，是检验冷暗物质模型有效性、理解环境效应（如潮汐剥离、冲压剥离导致的熄火 quenching）以及约束重子物理过程的关键途径。
\n长期以来，该领域的观测重点主要集中在类似银河系的大质量星系（$M_\star \gtrsim 10^{10} M_\odot$）周围，因为卫星星系相对容易通过巡天发现。然而，矮星系（Dwarf Galaxies，通常 $10^7 < M_\star < 10^{10} M_\odot$）作为宇宙中数量最庞大的星系群体，其周围的卫星系统往往被忽视。由于矮星系本身光度低、表面亮度暗，寻找其周围更微弱的卫星候选体面临巨大的观测挑战，主要障碍包括：1）背景/前景污染严重，难以通过视向速度或距离精确判定伴星关系；2）小质量卫星极易被观测极限截断，导致样本不完备。因此，系统性普查矮星系卫星对于理解低密度环境下的小尺度结构形成与恒星演化至关重要。
contribution:
- **样本构建与方法论**：介绍了“本地宇宙矮星系卫星系统普查”（ELVES-Dwarf）项目，这是一个系统性的矮星系卫星巡天。研究团队建立了由 39 个以孤立矮星系为主的宿主样本（恒星质量 $10^{7}<M_\star<10^{10}\,M_\odot$），利用 $155~\mathrm{deg}^2$ 的 Legacy Surveys 成像数据，在宿主投影维里半径内搜索卫星候选体。
- **卫星确认与物理性质**：结合 Subaru/HSC、Magellan/IMACS 和 Gemini/GMOS 的表面亮度涨落（SBF）距离，辅以文献中的红巨星分支（TRGB）距离和径向速度，从 207 个候选体中**严格确认了 39 颗恒星质量 $M_\star>10^5\,M_\odot$ 的卫星星系**。
- **观测结果与丰度统计**：在基准完备性极限（$M_\star\gtrsim10^{5.7}\,M_\odot$）下，分析了宿主与卫星的关系：21 个宿主无确认卫星，10 个拥有一颗，6 个拥有两颗，2 个拥有四颗。这揭示了**矮星系之间卫星丰度存在显著的宿主间离散度（host-to-host scatter）**。
- **理论对比（一致性检验）**：观测到的卫星丰度、恒星质量函数以及卫星的投影径向分布，总体上与 $\Lambda$CDM 宇宙学模拟 TNG50 的预测以及基于银河系卫星定标的星系形成模型**一致**。这表明矮星系周围的卫星群体在统计特性上符合标准的宇宙学层级结构预期。
- **环境效应的差异（核心发现）**：尽管统计性质相似，但**矮星系周围卫星的“熄灭”（quenched，即恒星形成停止）比例显著低于银河系质量宿主周围的卫星**。这一发现强烈暗示：**环境效应（如星系团中的冲压剥离等）在质量较小的暗物质晕中效率较低**，或者矮星系自身的引力势井不足以有效剥离其卫星的冷气体。
- **科学意义**：ELVES-Dwarf 提供了首个大规模的、距离确认的、同质性的矮星系卫星样本，为理解低密度环境中的小尺度星系形成与演化奠定了基础。
summary: We present the Exploration of Local VolumE Satellites of Dwarf Galaxies (ELVES-Dwarf) survey, a systematic census of satellite systems around dwarf hosts in the Local Volume. Our final sample comprises 39 predominantly isolated hosts with stellar masses $10^{7}<M_\star<10^{10}\,M_\odot$, including 32 hosts searched uniformly in this work and 7 drawn from the literature. We search for satellite candidates within the projected virial radius of each host using $155~\mathrm{deg}^2$ of Legacy Surveys imaging data. We determine satellite membership using surface brightness fluctuation distances from Subaru/HSC, Magellan/IMACS, and Gemini/GMOS imaging, supplemented by literature TRGB distances and radial velocities. From 207 candidates, we confirm 39 satellites with $M_\star>10^5\,M_\odot$ around the 39 hosts. Above our fiducial completeness threshold of $M_\star\gtrsim10^{5.7}\,M_\odot$ and within the projected virial radius, 21 hosts have no confirmed satellites, 10 have one, six have two, and two have four, revealing substantial host-to-host scatter in satellite abundance. Overall, the observed satellite abundances and stellar mass functions are broadly consistent with predictions from the cosmological simulation TNG50 and galaxy formation models calibrated using Milky Way satellites. The projected radial distribution of the satellites is also consistent with theoretical expectations and with satellite populations around Milky Way-mass hosts. In contrast, the quenched fraction of satellites around dwarf hosts is substantially lower than around Milky Way-mass hosts, suggesting that environmental quenching is less efficient in dwarf halos. ELVES-Dwarf provides the first large, homogeneous, distance-confirmed sample of satellites around dwarf hosts and establishes a foundation for understanding galaxy formation and evolution in less-dense environments.

title: The promise of self-supervised and active learning for Strong Lens discovery: Astronomaly applied to KiDS
background_knowledge: 强引力透镜（Strong Gravitational Lenses, SGLs）是宇宙中极其罕见但具有极高科学价值的前景系统。根据广义相对论，大质量前景天体（如星系或星系团）会弯曲背景光源发出的光线，形成多重像、爱因斯坦环或显著放大的弧状结构。SGLs 是研究暗物质分布、测量哈勃常数以及探索早期宇宙天体的关键探针。然而，随着下一代巡天项目（如 LSST/Rubin, Euclid）产生数十亿量级的图像数据，传统的人工筛选和依赖大规模模拟数据训练的监督学习算法面临瓶颈。监督学习往往受限于模拟数据与真实数据之间的域偏移（Domain Shift），且难以发现形态偏离模拟预期的奇异透镜系统。因此，减少对模拟数据的依赖并利用人类专家在环（Human-in-the-loop）的高效主动学习框架，成为提升透镜发现率和多样性的新范式。
contribution:
- 本文首次将 **Astronomaly:PROTEGE** 框架应用于强引力透镜发现，提出了一种无需依赖大规模模拟训练数据的 **人脑在环主动学习（Active Learning）** 新方法。
- 针对 Kilo-Degree Survey (KiDS) DR4 中 370 万个亮星系样本，研究利用预训练于 ImageNet 的卷积神经网络提取特征，并通过 **Bootstrap Your Own Latent (BYOL)** 自监督学习框架在 KiDS 数据上进行微调，构建了高维特征嵌入空间。
- 通过迭代式主动学习循环，系统从嵌入空间中自动选取最具信息量的候选目标供专家审查。仅对 **3,000 个目标** 进行人工检视，即获得了 **34 个高质量（Grade A/B）** 强引力透镜候选体。
- 基于已发现透镜在特征空间中的聚集性，研究进一步扩展样本，通过最近邻相似性分析共识别出 **140 个 Grade A/B 候选体** 和超过 **1,000 个 Grade C（低置信度）** 系统。
- 在新发现的 140 个高质量候选体中，**81 个为全新识别**，占总高质量候选体的约 60%；同时成功找回了约 22% 之前已知但未在单纯自动检测中突出的 KiDS 透镜。
- 该结果证明了该方法在 **Euclid、Roman 和 LSST/Rubin** 等下一代巡天中的巨大潜力，特别是在发现具有形态多样性的透镜系统方面，有效互补了传统监督学习方法并降低了对模拟数据的依赖。
summary: Strong gravitational lenses (SGLs) are rare systems whose discovery currently relies primarily on supervised machine learning methods trained on large simulated datasets. We present the first application of Astronomaly:PROTEGE to SGL discovery, demonstrating that a human-in-the-loop active learning framework can efficiently identify lenses in large imaging surveys without the need for simulated training data. We consider a sample of 3.7 million bright galaxies from the Kilo-Degree Survey (KiDS) DR4. Feature representations are extracted using a convolutional neural network pre-trained on the ImageNet dataset and subsequently fine-tuned on KiDS data using the self-supervised Bootstrap Your Own Latent (BYOL) framework. Within the embedding of these representations, the active learning loop of Astronomaly iteratively selects the most informative systems for expert inspection. A total of 3,000 objects are inspected across multiple rounds, yielding 34 high-quality (grade A/B) SGL candidates. On the basis that these systems occupy similar regions in the learned feature space, we expand this sample through nearest-neighbour similarity analysis. Including the active learning discoveries, we identify a total of 140 grade A/B candidates and more than 1,000 additional lower-confidence systems (grade C). Among the A/B candidates, 81 are newly identified, while approximately 22% of previously known grade A/B KiDS lenses are recovered. These results demonstrate strong potential for next-generation surveys such as Euclid, Roman, and Rubin's Legacy Survey of Space and Time. With approximately 60% of the high-quality candidates newly reported, this approach complements supervised methods by reducing reliance on simulations and enabling the discovery of a diverse population of SGLs.

title: Gravitational-wave signatures of primordial black hole clusters and the imprint of an early dense-core collapse
background_knowledge: 原初黑洞（PBHs）形成于宇宙极早期密度涨落的坍缩，与宇宙学曲率扰动的统计性质紧密相关。若扰动存在非高斯尾部，PBHs往往以高度聚集的星团形式诞生，且理论预测其初始自旋接近于零。在此背景下，观测到的PBH自旋必然源于后续动力学演化中的合并吸积过程。引力波天文学已成为检验PBH性质的关键手段，通过探测双黑洞合并产生的随机引力波背景以及LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA与未来的LISA对中等质量与恒星级黑洞波段的联合观测，可反推PBH的早期形成机制。利用高精度N体模拟（如Nbody6++GPU）处理近抛物线动力学俘获合并过程，是量化星团坍缩演化、自旋增长与引力波信号分布的核心范式。
contribution:
- 利用N体模拟定量刻画了初始无自旋PBH星团的演化，揭示了产生特定自旋与存活的张力：产生 $\chi_{\rm rms}\sim0.1 - 0.2$ 需初始 Plummer 半径 $10^{-5}\,{\rm pc}$，而宇宙学时间尺度存活要求秒差距（$\rm pc$）尺度。
- 提出自然解决方案：假设PBH形成时具有**嵌在延展暗物质晕中的致密短寿命核心**。模拟表明，核心块在数天至年内坍缩，产生**高偏心率（$e\to1$）、低轨道角动量**的动力学俘获合并。
- 核心合并的致密双星（DBB）遗迹自旋系统性低于准圆合并值 $\chi\simeq0.7$；其红移随机背景（SGWB）峰值处于 $10^{-6} - 10^{-4}\,{\rm Hz}$（LISA敏感频段），延展晕的长期演化则负责产生可被地面探测器观测到的常规双黑洞合并。
- 预测了**双重随机引力波背景（SGWB）**，并结合自旋与质量数据，**强烈支持PBH初始质量函数在 $50\,M_\odot$ 附近具有截断特征**。
summary: Primordial black holes (PBHs) are expected to be born essentially non-spinning and, if the primordial curvature fluctuations possess non-Gaussian tails, strongly clustered. Any spin measured in a PBH population must therefore be dynamically generated. Using direct $N$-body simulations with \textsc{nbody6++gpu}, modified to treat nearly parabolic dynamical-capture mergers, we quantify the conditions under which an initially non-spinning PBH cluster develops the spin, mass and stochastic-background signatures that gravitational-wave observations are now sensitive to. We find a sharp tension: producing a root-mean-square spin $χ_{\rm rms}\sim0.1 - 0.2$ in the $30 - 50\,M_\odot$ range requires initial Plummer radii of order $10^{-5}\,{\rm pc}$, whereas survival over cosmological times requires parsec-scale clusters. This tension is resolved naturally if PBHs form with a compact, short-lived core embedded in an extended halo, and we therefore simulate the two regimes as independent blocks. The core block ($4000$ PBHs, Plummer radii $3\times10^{-6} - 10^{-4}\,{\rm pc}$) collapses in days to years, producing a burst of mergers whose orbits are strongly non-circular ($e\to1$) and of low dimensionless orbital angular momentum, so that remnant spins are systematically below the quasi-circular value $χ\simeq0.7$. Redshifted from their formation epoch, the core mergers deposit a stochastic background peaking in the $10^{-6}$--$10^{-4}\,{\rm Hz}$ band accessible to LISA. The picture predicts a specific division of labour between observables, spins set in the primordial collapse, detectable mergers set by the long-term halo, and a two-component stochastic background, and, in particular, that both the spin and the mass data favour a primordial mass function truncated near $50\,M_\odot$.

title: Sulphur within the extreme environment of the central molecular zone of NGC 253: a chemical modelling approach
background_knowledge: 在星际介质（ISM）的研究中，硫（S）是一种重要的示踪元素。由于硫在宇宙丰度较低且化学性质复杂，其在气相中的观测丰度通常低于模型预测值，这种现象被称为“硫枯竭”（sulfur depletion）。然而，在恒星形成区，特别是涉及冲击波（shocks）和原恒星外流（outflows）的高温高密度环境中，硫的化学行为会发生显著变化。中心分子区（Central Molecular Zone, CMZ）是星系核心区域存在极高气体密度和湍流运动的特殊环境，通常伴随着活跃的恒星形成活动。对于外部星系（如NGC 253，一种星暴星系），解析其CMZ内个别分子云核的物理条件极具挑战性，因此，通过化学模型模拟不同物理过程（如静态暖云、C型冲击波、震后气体）下含硫分子的丰度演化，成为反推观测信号物理起源的关键范式。
contribution:
- 本研究利用 **UCLCHEM** 气-粒时依赖化学模型，在NGC 253中心分子区（CMZ）的极端物理条件下，模拟了静态暖云和 **C型冲击波** 中含硫分子的化学演化。
- 通过将模型输出的丰度与观测数据进行对比，发现不同物理环境（冲击波、震后气体、静态云）会导致含硫分子达到显著不同的最高丰度，从而提出 **含硫分子丰度可作为区分气体物理状态（激波/非激波）的诊断工具**。
- 研究证实了此前基于观测得出的结论，即NGC 253 CMZ中的硫发射主要与 **恒星形成活动** 相关，并指出在观测空间分辨率不足的情况下，化学模型仍能有效约束发射源的物理起源。
- 展示了将 **巨分子云（GMC）尺度的观测** 与化学建模相结合是研究外部恒星形成区分子发射机制的强力方法，确立了硫系分子在解析不同ISM组分中的实用价值。
summary: Sulphur(S)-bearing species are ubiquitous in Galactic star-forming regions, from dense cold cores to outflows and shocks linked to protostellar activity. A recent observational study investigated the origin of S-bearing species towards the central molecular zone (CMZ) of NGC 253 and showed that Sulphur emission is linked to the presence of forming stars. However, more extensive modelling of these observations are required to determine the exact origin of the Sulphur emission (e.g. shock or thermal evaporation). Using chemical modelling, we examine how S-bearing species behave in the more extreme environment of the starburst galaxy NGC 253, and more generally, how they can help us improve our understanding of the emission linked with the dense star-forming gas in external galaxies. We use the gas-grain time-dependent chemical model UCLCHEM to model static warm clouds and C-type shocks under the physical conditions found in the CMZ of NGC 253. We compare observed abundances and abundance ratios to the modelled output abundances. We found that depending on the model type (shock, post-shock or static cloud), the highest abundance reached by the S-bearing species varies significantly. Hence, we can use their observed abundances of S-bearing species to distinguish between shocked, post-shocked or a quiescent (non-shocked) gas. We also confirm observationally-based conclusions on their emission origins, including in the case of unresolved emission. Comparing GMC-scale observations with chemical modelling is a powerful method to investigate and constrain the origin of molecular emission towards extragalactic star-forming regions. Sulphur-bearing species are useful to distinguish between different types of ISM components (shocked/post-shocked/quiescent gas).
